title: Alberta Heat Continuity Playbook
trigger: Three-day maximum temperature forecast above the local facility threshold or an Alberta grid alert.
tier1_actions: Verify backup power and cooling-water reserves.
Move outdoor work to morning shifts.
tier2_actions: Move assembly volume to Ontario where capacity permits.
stand_down: Temperatures remain below the site threshold for 48 hours and grid alerts clear.
summary: Synthetic 2026 demo playbook for heat and cooling continuity at Alberta facilities.

title: British Columbia Wildfire and Smoke Response
trigger: Air quality health index reaches high risk or an active fire threatens a primary corridor.
tier1_actions: Issue respiratory protection for outdoor staff.
stand_down: Air quality returns to low risk and primary corridors reopen.
summary: Synthetic 2026 demo playbook for wildfire, smoke, and corridor disruption in British Columbia.

title: Prairie Flood and Rail Continuity
trigger: A flood warning affects the Red River corridor or a primary rail line is forecast to close.
tier1_actions: Raise critical inventory above ground level.
tier2_actions: Activate temporary storage outside the floodplain.
stand_down: Flood warnings clear and road and rail service return to normal.
summary: Synthetic 2026 demo playbook for Manitoba flood and national transshipment continuity.

title: Vancouver Distribution Centre Continuity
trigger: Vancouver Distribution Centre is offline for 24 hours or port, rail, or flood disruption blocks inbound freight.
tier1_actions: Use Prince George for northern deliveries.
Notify customers of revised lead times.
tier2_actions: Prioritize critical shipments for air freight.
stand_down: Vancouver throughput reaches 90 percent and the inbound queue falls below one day.
summary: Synthetic 2026 demo playbook for a 48-hour Vancouver distribution outage.

title: Atlantic Port and Coastal Storm Continuity
trigger: A coastal storm warning closes Halifax terminals or threatens power and road access.
tier1_actions: Move inbound components to secure storage.
stand_down: Port operations and utility service are stable for 24 hours.
summary: Synthetic 2026 demo playbook for Halifax coastal storm and port disruption.
